body: a heavy quadruped ore-hauler mecha-beast for volcanic industrial terrain, full clean side-profile reference view, standing on all four thick legs facing left, legs clearly separated and fully visible, a broad reinforced back rack for carrying raw ore (empty, no rider or cargo), a low heavy-browed armored head built like a rhinoceros or bull, thick protective faceplate. Obsidian-black #06080b structural plating (the SAME obsidian as the original SHADDAI spine -- this mount is where that material literally exists in-world, not just thematically), glowing magma-orange #ff6a2e seams running along every major joint like exposed lava cooling into rock, structural iron #3a3530 undercarriage. TURTLE'S NOTE: this is the heaviest, least graceful of the mounts on purpose -- thick tank-like proportions, built to survive heat and rockslides, not to look elegant. Scorch marks and heat-warping visible on the lower legs. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, dramatic magma-glow uplighting from below mixed with dark volcanic ambient light, plain flat dark-grey background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible head to tail, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
